question.problem:
$$
P=[\begin{aligned}0.35 & 0.15 \\ 0.65 & 0.85\end{aligned}],\,{x}_{0}=[\begin{aligned}0.3 \\ 0.7\end{aligned}]
$$

 

Consider a Markov chain with the stochastic matrix $P$ and the initial state vector ${x}_{0}$ given above. Calculate the state vector ${x}_{2}.$
question.worked_solution:
To find the state vector ${x}_{2},$ we apply two steps of the Markov chain:

$$
{x}_{1}=P{x}_{0},\,{x}_{2}=P{x}_{1}
$$

After the first step, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} & =P{x}_{0} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0.35 & 0.15 \\ 0.65 & 0.85\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}0.3 \\ 0.7\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0.21 \\ 0.79\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, after the second step, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{2} & =P{x}_{1} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0.35 & 0.15 \\ 0.65 & 0.85\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}0.21 \\ 0.79\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0.192 \\ 0.808\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
